tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Deep-water white of a nautical chart in light; night water in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised ground for cards, panels and inputs. The shallow-water tint of a chart.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Control outlines, dividers and chart hairlines. Border on bg and surface.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Wet slate. Headings and body copy. Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and captions. Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Starboard green, from the navigation light. The one primary action in a view, links and the focus ring. Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label of a filled accent control. Text on accent.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Port red, from the navigation light. Error text and destructive actions. Always pair it with a word or an icon. Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: lamp
tokens.usage: Lantern amber. A fill behind the next-tide marker only. Never a text color and never a second accent.

families.text: "IBM Plex Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Liberation Sans", sans-serif
families.condensed: "IBM Plex Sans Condensed", "IBM Plex Sans", "Arial Narrow", "Liberation Sans Narrow", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One hero headline in a view. Short lines, sentence case.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: All running text. The base size.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary text, table cells and form help.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Labels, captions and metadata, set in sentence case. Never for running text.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, identifiers and numbers that must align.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control; gap between related items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of cards and inputs; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; page gutter on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, chips and small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and cards. Corners stay tight: the brand is exact, not soft.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: A hairline lift under resting cards. Surfaces stay matte.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and raised cards.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback on controls.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs and panels that enter or leave.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default easing for every transition. No springs.
